title: Hotfix
description: Your robot is running in production with a broken six-step program. Patch one instruction per cycle to resolve procedural incident tickets. Backlog, Sprint and a daily challenge. English and French. Prod multiplayer is planned for M2.
controls: Mouse or touch: select a program slot, choose an instruction, then Deploy.
Keyboard: 1-6 select a slot; F B L R W J P choose an instruction; Enter or Space deploy; Escape cancels.
Arrow keys navigate program slots and title menu. Plus and minus change execution speed.
